proof_review.reason: For d=2^-12, (1+d)^2=1+2d+2^-24 lies exactly halfway between adjacent binary32 values; lower mantissa index is even, so product rounds down. Diagonal error is -d^2 and v=(-(1+d),1) therefore has energy -d^2. First pair_add cannot recover the rounded product residual.
